<Defaults>
  <Text color="#FFFFFF" alignment="MiddleLeft" />
  <Button fontSize="13" colors="#3a342e|#5a5048|#2a2622|#3a342e" textColor="#FFFFFF" />
</Defaults>
<Panel id="hnPanel" width="620" height="244" rectAlignment="UpperRight" offsetXY="-8 -64"
       allowDragging="true" returnToOriginalPositionWhenReleased="false" color="rgba(0,0,0,0)">
  <Button id="hnToggle" onClick="uiTogglePanel" width="40" height="24" rectAlignment="UpperRight"
          offsetXY="0 0" fontSize="12" text="HN" />
  <Panel id="hnBody" width="620" height="216" rectAlignment="LowerCenter" color="rgba(0,0,0,0.8)">
    <VerticalLayout padding="10 10 6 6" spacing="2" childForceExpandHeight="false">
      <Text id="hnVer" fontSize="12" color="#d8c49a" preferredHeight="18">Rules 1.9.0 · Roster 1.9.0 · Config batch_0075 · death 2/4/6 rounds · c25d76c</Text>
      <Text id="hnRound" fontSize="22" fontStyle="Bold" preferredHeight="28">Round 1</Text>
      <Text id="hnPrio" fontSize="15" preferredHeight="20">Priority</Text>
      <Text id="hnInfo" fontSize="13" color="#e8e0d0" preferredHeight="20">-</Text>
      <Text id="hnHint" fontSize="12" color="#b8b0a0" preferredHeight="34" horizontalOverflow="Wrap">-</Text>
      <Text id="hnAP" fontSize="15" fontStyle="Bold" color="#ebc43c" preferredHeight="20">AP pool</Text>
      <HorizontalLayout spacing="4" preferredHeight="28" childForceExpandWidth="true">
        <Button onClick="uiStartGame" text="Start game" />
        <Button onClick="uiNextPhase" text="Next phase ▶" />
        <Button onClick="uiNextActivation" text="Next activation ▶" />
        <Button onClick="uiMapView" text="Map view" />
        <Button onClick="uiRelayout" text="Re-layout" />
        <Button onClick="uiFlipArt" text="Art 180°" />
      </HorizontalLayout>
    </VerticalLayout>
  </Panel>
</Panel>

ObjectStates.LuaScript:
-- Hex-Nexus hexgroup tile. Two states: 1 = hidden side, 2 = visible side.
-- Flipping swaps the state; the Global script re-fits the new state.
function onLoad()
  self.addContextMenuItem("Flip hexgroup", function()
    Global.call("hnFlipTile", {guid = self.getGUID()})
  end)
end

ObjectStates.Name: Custom_Token
ObjectStates.Description: Starts 15 HP; decays to floor 6. Left-click -1, right-click +1.
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
-- Hex-Nexus HP counter: champions, towers, the Nexus, monsters and waves.
-- Left-click removes 1, right-click adds 1. The Global script hears every
-- change (hnCounterChanged): it banks AP for chips, handles kills, falls and
-- rewards. Starting numbers come from the exporter, never from this file.
local st = {}

function onLoad(saved)
  local ok, t = pcall(JSON.decode, saved or "")
  if ok and type(t) == "table" then st = t end
  st.hp = st.hp or 0
  st.max = st.max or st.hp
  draw()
end

function onSave() return JSON.encode(st) end

function hnGet() return st end

function hnSet(t)
  for k, v in pairs(t or {}) do st[k] = v end
  draw()
end

local function label()
  if st.kind == "champion" then
    if st.hp <= 0 then return "DEAD" end
    return st.hp .. "/" .. st.max
  elseif st.kind == "structure" then
    if st.hp <= 0 then return "destroyed" end
    return st.hp .. " (min " .. (st.floor or 0) .. ")"
  elseif st.kind == "monster" and st.hp <= 0 then
    return "down · R" .. (st.respawn_round or "?")
  end
  return tostring(st.hp)
end

function draw()
  self.clearButtons()
  local s = self.getScale()
  local k = 1 / math.max(s.x, 0.01)
  -- local half-depth of the token, so the label sits on its lower edge
  -- (local +z is the bottom of the image) and leaves the art readable
  local b = self.getBoundsNormalized()
  local half = 0.5
  if b and b.size and s.z > 0 then half = b.size.z / s.z / 2 end
  local colour = {0, 0, 0, 0.75}
  if st.kind == "champion" and st.hp > st.max then colour = {0.55, 0.42, 0.05, 0.85} end
  if st.hp <= 0 then colour = {0.45, 0.05, 0.05, 0.85} end
  local text = label()
  self.createButton({
    click_function = "hnClick", function_owner = self, label = text,
    position = {0, 0.2, half * 0.72}, rotation = {0, 0, 0}, scale = {k * 0.5, 1, k * 0.5},
    width = 110 * #text + 160, height = 260, font_size = 200,
    color = colour, font_color = {1, 1, 1},
    tooltip = (st.label or "") .. ": left-click -1, right-click +1",
  })
end

function hnClick(_, player_colour, alt)
  local before = st.hp
  st.hp = math.max(0, st.hp + (alt and 1 or -1))
  draw()
  if st.hp ~= before then
    Global.call("hnCounterChanged", {guid = self.getGUID(), before = before, after = st.hp,
                                     colour = player_colour})
  end
end

ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
-- Hex-Nexus card: champion cards count their own cooldown, buff and item
-- cards are played or bought from their right-click menu.
--   champ: READY / CD n / DEAD n. "Use <ability>" pays its AP and puts the
--          whole card on cooldown (Rules 5.2). Click: -1 / +1 cooldown.
--   buff:  Dragon is reusable (cooldown); Blue and Red Buff are one use.
--   item:  "Buy" pays its cost in the Shop Phase.
local st = {}

function onLoad(saved)
  local ok, t = pcall(JSON.decode, saved or "")
  if ok and type(t) == "table" then st = t end
  st.track = st.track or 0
  build()
end

function onSave() return JSON.encode(st) end
function hnGet() return st end

function hnSet(t)
  for k, v in pairs(t or {}) do st[k] = v end
  build()
end

local function status()
  if st.kind == "item" then
    if st.bought then return "OWNED", {0.15, 0.35, 0.15, 0.9} end
    return st.cost .. " AP", {0, 0, 0, 0.75}
  end
  if st.kind == "buff" and st.buff ~= "dragon" then
    if st.buff == "baron" then return "BARON", {0.35, 0.15, 0.45, 0.9} end
    return "PLAY", {0, 0, 0, 0.75}
  end
  if st.dead then return "DEAD " .. st.track, {0.5, 0.05, 0.05, 0.9} end
  if st.track > 0 then return "CD " .. st.track, {0.45, 0.3, 0.05, 0.9} end
  return "READY", {0.1, 0.4, 0.15, 0.9}
end

function build()
  self.clearButtons()
  self.clearContextMenu()
  local text, colour = status()
  local s = self.getScale()
  local k = 1 / math.max(s.x, 0.01)
  self.createButton({
    click_function = "hnClick", function_owner = self, label = text,
    position = {0, 0.3, -0.6}, rotation = {0, 0, 0}, scale = {k * 0.5, 1, k * 0.5},
    width = 1500, height = 380, font_size = 300, color = colour, font_color = {1, 1, 1},
    tooltip = "Left-click -1, right-click +1 (cooldown)",
  })
  if st.kind == "champ" then
    for _, key in ipairs(st.order or {}) do
      local a = st.ab[key]
      self.addContextMenuItem("Use " .. key .. " · " .. a.cost .. " AP · CD" .. a.cd, function(colour)
        Global.call("hnUseAbility", {guid = self.getGUID(), key = key, colour = colour})
      end)
    end
  elseif st.kind == "buff" then
    self.addContextMenuItem("Play " .. (st.name or "card"), function(colour)
      Global.call("hnPlayBuff", {guid = self.getGUID(), colour = colour})
    end)
  elseif st.kind == "item" and not st.bought then
    self.addContextMenuItem("Buy · " .. st.cost .. " AP", function(colour)
      Global.call("hnBuyItem", {guid = self.getGUID(), colour = colour})
    end)
  end
end

function hnClick(_, _, alt)
  if st.kind == "item" or (st.kind == "buff" and st.buff ~= "dragon") then return end
  st.track = math.max(0, st.track + (alt and 1 or -1))
  if st.track == 0 then st.dead = false end
  build()
end

ContainedObjects.Name: Custom_Token
ContainedObjects.Description: Top · HP 7 · Speed 2. Left-click -1 HP, right-click +1.
ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
-- Hex-Nexus HP counter: champions, towers, the Nexus, monsters and waves.
-- Left-click removes 1, right-click adds 1. The Global script hears every
-- change (hnCounterChanged): it banks AP for chips, handles kills, falls and
-- rewards. Starting numbers come from the exporter, never from this file.
local st = {}

function onLoad(saved)
  local ok, t = pcall(JSON.decode, saved or "")
  if ok and type(t) == "table" then st = t end
  st.hp = st.hp or 0
  st.max = st.max or st.hp
  draw()
end

function onSave() return JSON.encode(st) end

function hnGet() return st end

function hnSet(t)
  for k, v in pairs(t or {}) do st[k] = v end
  draw()
end

local function label()
  if st.kind == "champion" then
    if st.hp <= 0 then return "DEAD" end
    return st.hp .. "/" .. st.max
  elseif st.kind == "structure" then
    if st.hp <= 0 then return "destroyed" end
    return st.hp .. " (min " .. (st.floor or 0) .. ")"
  elseif st.kind == "monster" and st.hp <= 0 then
    return "down · R" .. (st.respawn_round or "?")
  end
  return tostring(st.hp)
end

function draw()
  self.clearButtons()
  local s = self.getScale()
  local k = 1 / math.max(s.x, 0.01)
  -- local half-depth of the token, so the label sits on its lower edge
  -- (local +z is the bottom of the image) and leaves the art readable
  local b = self.getBoundsNormalized()
  local half = 0.5
  if b and b.size and s.z > 0 then half = b.size.z / s.z / 2 end
  local colour = {0, 0, 0, 0.75}
  if st.kind == "champion" and st.hp > st.max then colour = {0.55, 0.42, 0.05, 0.85} end
  if st.hp <= 0 then colour = {0.45, 0.05, 0.05, 0.85} end
  local text = label()
  self.createButton({
    click_function = "hnClick", function_owner = self, label = text,
    position = {0, 0.2, half * 0.72}, rotation = {0, 0, 0}, scale = {k * 0.5, 1, k * 0.5},
    width = 110 * #text + 160, height = 260, font_size = 200,
    color = colour, font_color = {1, 1, 1},
    tooltip = (st.label or "") .. ": left-click -1, right-click +1",
  })
end

function hnClick(_, player_colour, alt)
  local before = st.hp
  st.hp = math.max(0, st.hp + (alt and 1 or -1))
  draw()
  if st.hp ~= before then
    Global.call("hnCounterChanged", {guid = self.getGUID(), before = before, after = st.hp,
                                     colour = player_colour})
  end
end

Top · HP 7 · Speed 2

Q  0 AP · CD 1 · HIT×2 r1 → PUSH 1 ↳
W  1 AP · CD 1 · SHIELD 3 r2 ✚
E  1 AP · CD 2 · DASH 2 → ROOT r1 ◆
R  3 AP · CD 3 · AREA r1 → ROOT area r1 ◆
ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
-- Hex-Nexus card: champion cards count their own cooldown, buff and item
-- cards are played or bought from their right-click menu.
--   champ: READY / CD n / DEAD n. "Use <ability>" pays its AP and puts the
--          whole card on cooldown (Rules 5.2). Click: -1 / +1 cooldown.
--   buff:  Dragon is reusable (cooldown); Blue and Red Buff are one use.
--   item:  "Buy" pays its cost in the Shop Phase.
local st = {}

function onLoad(saved)
  local ok, t = pcall(JSON.decode, saved or "")
  if ok and type(t) == "table" then st = t end
  st.track = st.track or 0
  build()
end

function onSave() return JSON.encode(st) end
function hnGet() return st end

function hnSet(t)
  for k, v in pairs(t or {}) do st[k] = v end
  build()
end

local function status()
  if st.kind == "item" then
    if st.bought then return "OWNED", {0.15, 0.35, 0.15, 0.9} end
    return st.cost .. " AP", {0, 0, 0, 0.75}
  end
  if st.kind == "buff" and st.buff ~= "dragon" then
    if st.buff == "baron" then return "BARON", {0.35, 0.15, 0.45, 0.9} end
    return "PLAY", {0, 0, 0, 0.75}
  end
  if st.dead then return "DEAD " .. st.track, {0.5, 0.05, 0.05, 0.9} end
  if st.track > 0 then return "CD " .. st.track, {0.45, 0.3, 0.05, 0.9} end
  return "READY", {0.1, 0.4, 0.15, 0.9}
end

function build()
  self.clearButtons()
  self.clearContextMenu()
  local text, colour = status()
  local s = self.getScale()
  local k = 1 / math.max(s.x, 0.01)
  self.createButton({
    click_function = "hnClick", function_owner = self, label = text,
    position = {0, 0.3, -0.6}, rotation = {0, 0, 0}, scale = {k * 0.5, 1, k * 0.5},
    width = 1500, height = 380, font_size = 300, color = colour, font_color = {1, 1, 1},
    tooltip = "Left-click -1, right-click +1 (cooldown)",
  })
  if st.kind == "champ" then
    for _, key in ipairs(st.order or {}) do
      local a = st.ab[key]
      self.addContextMenuItem("Use " .. key .. " · " .. a.cost .. " AP · CD" .. a.cd, function(colour)
        Global.call("hnUseAbility", {guid = self.getGUID(), key = key, colour = colour})
      end)
    end
  elseif st.kind == "buff" then
    self.addContextMenuItem("Play " .. (st.name or "card"), function(colour)
      Global.call("hnPlayBuff", {guid = self.getGUID(), colour = colour})
    end)
  elseif st.kind == "item" and not st.bought then
    self.addContextMenuItem("Buy · " .. st.cost .. " AP", function(colour)
      Global.call("hnBuyItem", {guid = self.getGUID(), colour = colour})
    end)
  end
end

function hnClick(_, _, alt)
  if st.kind == "item" or (st.kind == "buff" and st.buff ~= "dragon") then return end
  st.track = math.max(0, st.track + (alt and 1 or -1))
  if st.track == 0 then st.dead = false end
  build()
end

--   champ: READY / CD n / DEAD n. "Use <ability>" pays its AP and puts the
--          whole card on cooldown (Rules 5.2). Click: -1 / +1 cooldown.
--   buff:  Dragon is reusable (cooldown); Blue and Red Buff are one use.
--   item:  "Buy" pays its cost in the Shop Phase.
local st = {}

function onLoad(saved)
  local ok, t = pcall(JSON.decode, saved or "")
  if ok and type(t) == "table" then st = t end
  st.track = st.track or 0
  build()
end

function onSave() return JSON.encode(st) end
function hnGet() return st end

function hnSet(t)
  for k, v in pairs(t or {}) do st[k] = v end
  build()
end

local function status()
  if st.kind == "item" then
    if st.bought then return "OWNED", {0.15, 0.35, 0.15, 0.9} end
    return st.cost .. " AP", {0, 0, 0, 0.75}
  end
  if st.kind == "buff" and st.buff ~= "dragon" then
    if st.buff == "baron" then return "BARON", {0.35, 0.15, 0.45, 0.9} end
    return "PLAY", {0, 0, 0, 0.75}
  end
  if st.dead then return "DEAD " .. st.track, {0.5, 0.05, 0.05, 0.9} end
  if st.track > 0 then return "CD " .. st.track, {0.45, 0.3, 0.05, 0.9} end
  return "READY", {0.1, 0.4, 0.15, 0.9}
end

function build()
  self.clearButtons()
  self.clearContextMenu()
  local text, colour = status()
  local s = self.getScale()
  local k = 1 / math.max(s.x, 0.01)
  self.createButton({
    click_function = "hnClick", function_owner = self, label = text,
    position = {0, 0.3, -0.6}, rotation = {0, 0, 0}, scale = {k * 0.5, 1, k * 0.5},
    width = 1500, height = 380, font_size = 300, color = colour, font_color = {1, 1, 1},
    tooltip = "Left-click -1, right-click +1 (cooldown)",
  })
  if st.kind == "champ" then
    for _, key in ipairs(st.order or {}) do
      local a = st.ab[key]
      self.addContextMenuItem("Use " .. key .. " · " .. a.cost .. " AP · CD" .. a.cd, function(colour)
        Global.call("hnUseAbility", {guid = self.getGUID(), key = key, colour = colour})
      end)
    end
  elseif st.kind == "buff" then
    self.addContextMenuItem("Play " .. (st.name or "card"), function(colour)
      Global.call("hnPlayBuff", {guid = self.getGUID(), colour = colour})
    end)
  elseif st.kind == "item" and not st.bought then
    self.addContextMenuItem("Buy · " .. st.cost .. " AP", function(colour)
      Global.call("hnBuyItem", {guid = self.getGUID(), colour = colour})
    end)
  end
end

function hnClick(_, _, alt)
  if st.kind == "item" or (st.kind == "buff" and st.buff ~= "dragon") then return end
  st.track = math.max(0, st.track + (alt and 1 or -1))
  if st.track == 0 then st.dead = false end
  build()
end
